reason: Anycubic Slicer Next and an equivalent local slicer executable are not installed in the validation environment.
required_user_checks: Open all three R4 core 3MF files in Anycubic Slicer Next.
Confirm one aligned catcher and full upright logos on front, impact and display faces.
If 3MF import fails, jointly import all five catcher STLs without auto-arranging them.
Inspect every layer for true honeycomb openings, open bottom, open intake, solid upper impact band and two vertical slots.
Record sliced time, filament and purge-waste estimates.
release_effect: Blocks destination-slicer and physical release gates.
